failure: Worker readback can finish before deferred GUI opener; source/settings/export may change while callback is queued.
mechanism: Use native application menu tracking to attempt a bounded hold of wx deferred completion, without changing production code or original inputs.
budget: At most one fresh GUI route/review/accept/export per fault; no reroute retry if queue hold fails. Every final candidate retains actual Native/original checks and complete pre-mutation proof. GUI waiting/authoring time separate and unmeasured.

faults.source: append whitespace to disposable source project companion after successful inspect worker
faults.settings: append whitespace to disposable workspace/settings.json after successful inspect worker
faults.export: change export_accepted:true to integer1 in disposable export/export.json after successful inspect worker

decision: Qualify only controls whose successful worker and queued UI boundary are observed; otherwise retain failure/uncertainty, do not claim callback coverage.
